skill.name: teach
skill.description: Create a structured teaching workspace that plans lessons, records progress, and grounds instruction in trusted resources.
skill.summary: Turns any topic into a mission-based learning workspace with lessons, records, and curated references.
skill.author: mattpocock

content.value_statement: Many learners lose context between AI teaching sessions. This skill creates a durable workspace with missions, resources, lessons, and learning records.
actual_capabilities: Creates a mission document that ties lessons to a real learner goal.
Maintains learning records that capture demonstrated understanding and prior knowledge.
Builds HTML lessons focused on one tightly scoped topic.
Curates resources and communities that support evidence-based teaching.
Creates reference documents such as glossaries, cheat sheets, and quick guides.
Adapts future lessons using the learner mission and recorded progress.
limitations: Requires user input to define mission, constraints, and prior knowledge.
Quality depends on the resources added to the workspace.
Does not independently verify advice from external communities.
May need browser or file access to create rich HTML lessons.

use_cases.title: Create a personal study track
use_cases.description: Turn a broad learning goal into a mission, first lesson, and progress record.

use_cases.title: Support skill coaching
use_cases.description: Prepare small lessons, practice loops, and references for repeated coaching sessions.

use_cases.title: Preserve learning context
use_cases.description: Track what a learner understands so future sessions do not repeat known material.

prompt_templates.title: Start a new topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Teach me [topic]. First ask why I want to learn it, then create a mission and first lesson plan.

prompt_templates.title: Create the first lesson
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my mission to create one short lesson on [specific skill]. Include practice, feedback, and trusted citations.

prompt_templates.title: Update my progress
prompt_templates.prompt: I already understand [concept]. Record what this changes for future lessons and choose the next useful topic.

prompt_templates.title: Design a learning sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the mission, resources, and learning records. Propose the next three lessons with outcomes and required references.

output_examples.input: I want to learn SQL so I can review product analytics at work.
output_examples.output: A mission focused on workplace analytics, a first lesson on reading SELECT queries, and a short practice exercise.

output_examples.input: I already know basic guitar chords but struggle with rhythm.
output_examples.output: A learning record for existing chord knowledge, then a lesson plan focused on timing, strumming patterns, and feedback.

output_examples.input: Build a reference sheet for terms from today lesson.
output_examples.output: A concise glossary with only understood terms, preferred labels, and notes about ambiguous vocabulary.

best_practices: Start by defining a concrete mission and success criteria.
Add trusted resources before generating detailed lessons.
Record demonstrated understanding after each meaningful session.
anti_patterns: Teaching broad topics without a specific mission.
Treating learning records as session logs.
Using unsupported sources or bare links without annotations.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a teaching workspace with a mission, resources, lessons, learning records, notes, and reference documents.

faq.question: Does it work for non-coding topics?
faq.answer: Yes. The format supports topics such as fitness, music, writing, research, and programming.

faq.question: Why does it ask for a mission?
faq.answer: The mission keeps lessons tied to a real outcome and helps choose the right next topic.

faq.question: Can it remember what I already know?
faq.answer: Yes. It records demonstrated understanding and prior knowledge in learning records.

faq.question: Does it browse the web automatically?
faq.answer: No. It can use trusted resources when available, but browsing depends on the active tool environment.

faq.question: Is it a full learning management system?
faq.answer: No. It is a lightweight workspace pattern for guided lessons and durable learning context.
